hints.title: Greedy Monotonic Ordering
hints.text: To make the sequence lexicographically smallest, place smaller letters as early as possible, provided removed larger letters appear again later in the string.

hints.title: Last Occurrence Map
hints.text: Record the last index of each character in s. An item can only be safely popped from the result buffer if its last occurrence occurs after the current position.

hints.title: Stack Deduplication Maintenance
hints.text: Maintain an active character list and a set of included characters. For each character not yet in the set, pop larger elements that appear later, then append the new character.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all valid distinct subsequences explores combinatorial possibilities.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A monotonic stack with last occurrence indices runs in linear O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize monotonic stack with last-occurrence lookup (identical to LeetCode 316).
complexity.notes: Each letter in the alphabet is added and popped at most once.
